```python
# 生成 Excel 文件 (腾讯文档可直接打开)
import openpyxl
from datetime import datetime

def save_to_excel(news_list):
    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "金十快讯"
    
    # 标题行
    ws.append(["时间", "标题", "链接", "来源"])
    
    for n in news_list:
        ws.append([
            datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
            n['title'][:100],
            n.get('link', ''),
            n.get('source', '金十快讯')
        ])
    
    filename = f"jin10_news_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.xlsx"
    wb.save(filename)
    print(f"已保存: {filename}")
    return filename
```

def fetch_jin10():

    news = []
    try:
        url = "https://flash.jin10.com/"
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={
            'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
            'Referer': 'https://flash.jin10.com/',
        })
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as r:
            content = r.read().decode('utf-8')
        
        # 提取快讯ID
        ids = re.findall(r'/detail/(\d{17,20})', content)
        ids = list(dict.fromkeys(ids))[:30]
        
        for id in ids:
            detail_url = f"https://flash.jin10.com/detail/{id}"
            try:
                req2 = urllib.request.Request(detail_url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req2, timeout=8) as r2:
                    detail = r2.read().decode('utf-8')
                
                title_match = re.search(r'<title>([^<]+)</title>', detail)
                if title_match:
                    title = title_match.group(1).replace(' - 金十数据', '').strip()
                    title = re.sub(r'^【金十数据】', '', title)
                    
                    news.append({
                        "title": title,
                        "url": detail_url,
                        "ts": time.time()
                    })
            except:
                pass
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Jin10] Error: {e}")
    return news

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
NewsHub Core - 新闻抓取核心模块
"""
import sys
import json
import ssl
import re
import time
import hashlib
import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).parent
CONFIG_FILE = BASE_DIR / "sources.json"


def load_config():
    with open(CONFIG_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        return json.load(f)


def get_ssl():
    ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
    ctx.check_hostname = False
    ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
    return ctx


def hash_text(t):
    return hashlib.md5(t.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:12]


# ============================================================
# 金十快讯
# ============================================================

def fetch_jin10(limit=20):
    """抓取金十快讯"""
    news = []
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request("https://flash.jin10.com/", headers={
            'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
        })
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15, context=get_ssl()) as r:
            content = r.read().decode('utf-8')
        
        ids = list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r'/detail/(\d{17,20})', content)))[:limit]
        
        for id in ids:
            try:
                req2 = urllib.request.Request(f"https://flash.jin10.com/detail/{id}",
                    headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req2, timeout=8, context=get_ssl()) as r2:
                    detail = r2.read().decode('utf-8')
                
                m = re.search(r'<title>([^<]+)</title>', detail)
                if m:
                    title = m.group(1).replace(' - 金十数据', '').strip()
                    title = re.sub(r'^【金十数据】', '', title)
                    news.append({
                        "title": title,
                        "url": f"https://flash.jin10.com/detail/{id}",
                        "source": "金十快讯",
                        "ts": time.time()
                    })
                time.sleep(0.2)
            except:
                pass
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Jin10] Error: {e}")
    return news


# ============================================================
# RSS 源
# ============================================================

def fetch_rss(url):
    """抓取 RSS 源"""
    news = []
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15, context=get_ssl()) as r:
            content = r.read().decode('utf-8')
        
        root = ET.fromstring(content)
        for item in root.findall('.//item')[:15]:
            title = (item.findtext('title') or '').strip()
            link = item.findtext('link') or ''
            desc = (item.findtext('description') or '')[:200]
            
            if title and link:
                news.append({
                    "title": title,
                    "url": link,
                    "content": desc,
                    "source": url.split('/')[2],
                    "ts": time.time()
                })
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[RSS] Error {url}: {e}")
    return news


# ============================================================
# 主函数
# ============================================================

def fetch_all():
    """抓取所有启用的新闻源"""
    config = load_config()
    all_news = []

def fetch_jin10(limit=20):

        for item in root.findall('.//item')[:15]:

            link = item.findtext('link') or ''
            desc = (item.findtext('description') or '')[:200]
            
            if title and link:

                    "url": link,
                    "content": desc,
                    "source": url.split('/')[2],

                })

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
NewsHub Core - 新闻抓取核心模块
"""
import sys
import json
import ssl
import re
import time
import hashlib
import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).parent
CONFIG_FILE = BASE_DIR / "sources.json"


def load_config():
    with open(CONFIG_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        return json.load(f)


def get_ssl():
    ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
    ctx.check_hostname = False
    ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
    return ctx


def hash_text(t):
    return hashlib.md5(t.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()[:12]


# ============================================================
# 输出美化
# ============================================================

class Output:
    RESET = '\033[0m'
    BOLD = '\033[1m'
    CYAN = '\033[36m'
    GREEN = '\033[32m'
    YELLOW = '\033[33m'
    BLUE = '\033[34m'
    RED = '\033[31m'
    
    @staticmethod
    def header(text):
        print(f"\n{Output.BOLD}{Output.CYAN}{'─' * 50}{Output.RESET}")
        print(f"{Output.BOLD}{Output.CYAN}  {text}{Output.RESET}")
        print(f"{Output.BOLD}{Output.CYAN}{'─' * 50}{Output.RESET}\n")
    
    @staticmethod
    def info(text):
        print(f"{Output.BLUE}[INFO]{Output.RESET} {text}")
    
    @staticmethod
    def success(text):
        print(f"{Output.GREEN}[OK]  {Output.RESET}{text}")
    
    @staticmethod
    def warn(text):
        print(f"{Output.YELLOW}[WARN]{Output.RESET} {text}")
    
    @staticmethod
    def error(text):
        print(f"{Output.RED}[ERR] {Output.RESET}{text}")
    
    @staticmethod
    def item(num, title, source=""):
        source_str = f" {Output.CYAN}[{source}]{Output.RESET}" if source else ""
        title = title[:60] + "..." if len(title) > 60 else title
        print(f"  {Output.YELLOW}{num:2d}.{Output.RESET} {title}{source_str}")


# ============================================================
# 金十快讯
# ============================================================

def fetch_jin10(limit=20):
    """抓取金十快讯"""
    news = []
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request("https://flash.jin10.com/", headers={
            'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
        })
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15, context=get_ssl()) as r:
            content = r.read().decode('utf-8')
        
        ids = list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r'/detail/(\d{17,20})', content)))[:limit]
        
        for id in ids:
            try:
                req2 = urllib.request.Request(f"https://flash.jin10.com/detail/{id}",
                    headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req2, timeout=8, context=get_ssl()) as r2:
                    detail = r2.read().decode('utf-8')
                
                m = re.search(r'<title>([^<]+)</title>', detail)
                if m:
                    title = m.group(1).replace(' - 金十数据', '').strip()
                    title = re.sub(r'^【金十数据】', '', title)
                    news.append({
                        "title": title,
                        "url": f"https://flash.jin10.com/detail/{id}",
                        "source": "金十快讯",
                        "ts": time.time()
                    })
                time.sleep(0.2)
            except:
                pass
    except Exception as e:
        Output.error(f"金十快讯: {e}")
    return news


# ============================================================
# RSS 源
# ============================================================

def fetch_rss(url, name=""):
    """抓取 RSS 源"""
    news = []
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15, context=get_ssl()) as r:
            content = r.read().decode('utf-8')
        
        root = ET.fromstring(content)
        for item in root.findall('.//item')[:15]:
            title = (item.findtext('title') or '').strip()
            link = item.findtext('link') or ''
            desc = (item.findtext('description') or '')[:150]
            
            if title and link:
                news.append({
                    "title": title,
                    "url": link,
                    "content": desc,
                    "source": name or url.split('/')[2],
                    "ts": time.time()
                })
    except Exception as e:
        Output.warn(f"{name}: {str(e)[:50]}")
    return news


# ============================================================
# 主函数
# ============================================================

def fetch_all():
    """抓取所有启用的新闻源"""
    config = load_config()
    all_news = []
    
    Output.header("NewsHub Fetcher")
    Output.info(f"Time: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    
    sources = config.get('news_sources', {})
    
    for key, src in sources.items():
        if not src.get('enable', True):
            continue
        
        name = src.get('name', key)
        Output.info(f"Fetching {name}...")
        
        if key == 'jin10':
            news = fetch_jin10(src.get('limit', 20))
        else:
            news = fetch_rss(src['url'], name)
        
        if news:
            Output.success(f"{name}: +{len(news)} items")
        else:
            Output.warn(f"{name}: 0 items")
        
        all_news.extend(news)
    
    # 按时间排序
    all_news.sort(key=lambda x: x.get('ts', 0), reverse=True)
    
    Output.header("Results")
    print(f"  Total: {Output.BOLD}{len(all_news)}{Output.RESET} items\n")
    
    return all_news


def show_news(news, limit=10):
    """显示新闻列表"""
    for i, n in enumerate(news[:limit], 1):
        Output.item(i, n['title'], n.get('source', ''))


def filter_new(news, history):
    """过滤已发送的新闻"""
    new = []
    for n in news:
        if n['title'] not in history:
            new.append(n)
    return new


if __name__ == "__main__":
    news = fetch_all()
    show_news(news)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
NewsHub Feishu - 飞书推送
"""
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
from news_fetcher import fetch_all, load_config, Output

from datetime import datetime
import json
import ssl
import time
import urllib.request

BASE_DIR = Path(r'D:\OpenClaw\workspace\30-scripts-tools')
CONFIG_FILE = BASE_DIR / "feishu-tools" / "feishu-config.json"
HISTORY_FILE = BASE_DIR / "news_history.json"


def load_feishu_config():
    if CONFIG_FILE.exists():
        with open(CONFIG_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            return json.load(f)
    return {}


def load_history():
    if HISTORY_FILE.exists():
        with open(HISTORY_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            data = json.load(f)
            if isinstance(data, list):
                return data
            return data.get('sent', [])
    return []


def save_history(hist):
    with open(HISTORY_FILE, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(hist[-1000:] if len(hist) > 1000 else hist, f, ensure_ascii=False)


def get_access_token():
    """获取 access token"""
    cfg = load_feishu_config()
    url = "https://open.feishu.cn/open-apis/auth/v3/tenant_access_token/internal"
    data = {"app_id": cfg['app_id'], "app_secret": cfg['app_secret']}
    
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=json.dumps(data).encode(), 
                                  headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
    
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10, context=ctx) as r:
        result = json.loads(r.read())
        return result.get('tenant_access_token', '')


def send_message(token, receive_id, title, url):
    """发送消息"""
    cfg = load_feishu_config()
    api_url = "https://open.feishu.cn/open-apis/im/v1/messages"
    params = f"?receive_id_type={cfg.get('receive_id_type', 'open_id')}"
    
    content = {
        "zh_cn": {
            "title": title[:30],
            "content": [[{"tag": "a", "text": "查看详情", "href": url}]]
        }
    }
    
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        api_url + params,
        data=json.dumps({
            "receive_id": receive_id,
            "msg_type": "post",
            "content": json.dumps(content)
        }).encode(),
        headers={
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}'
        },
        method='POST'
    )
    
    ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15, context=ctx) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read())


def main():
    mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "all"
    config = load_config()
    feishu = load_feishu_config()
    
    receive_id = feishu.get('default_receive_id', '')
    
    Output.header("NewsHub Feishu")
    Output.info(f"Mode: {mode}")
    Output.info(f"Time: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    
    # 抓取
    all_news = fetch_all()
    
    if not all_news:
        Output.warn("No news fetched")
        return
    
    # 去重
    history = load_history()
    new_news = [n for n in all_news if n['title'] not in history]
    Output.info(f"Total: {len(all_news)} | New: {len(new_news)}")
    
    if not new_news:
        Output.warn("No new news to send")
        return
    
    # 模式筛选
    keywords = config.get('keywords', [])
    
    if mode == "alert":
        items = [n for n in new_news if any(kw in n['title'] for kw in keywords)]
        Output.info(f"Alert filter: {len(keywords)} keywords")
    elif mode == "digest":
        items = new_news[:5]
    else:
        items = new_news[:10]
    
    if not items:
        Output.warn("No items match filter")
        return
    
    # 获取 token
    token = get_access_token()
    if not token:
        Output.error("Failed to get token")
        return
    
    Output.info(f"Token: {token[:15]}...")
    print()
    
    # 发送
    sent = 0
    for n in items:
        try:
            result = send_message(token, receive_id, n['title'], n['url'])
            if result.get('code') == 0:
                history.append(n['title'])
                Output.success(f"{n['title'][:45]}...")
                sent += 1
            else:
                Output.error(f"Code {result.get('code')}: {result.get('msg', '')}")
            time.sleep(0.3)
        except Exception as e:
            Output.error(f"{e}")
            break
    
    save_history(history)
    
    print()
    Output.header("Summary")
    print(f"  Mode:     {mode}")
    print(f"  Fetched:  {len(all_news)}")
    print(f"  New:      {len(new_news)}")
    print(f"  Sent:     {Output.BOLD}{sent}{Output.RESET}")
    
    if sent == len(items):
        print(f"\n  {Output.GREEN}All messages sent successfully!{Output.RESET}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
NewsHub Core - 新闻抓取
"""
import sys
import json
import ssl
import re
import time
import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).parent
CONFIG_FILE = BASE_DIR / "sources.json"

# ============================================================
# 美化输出
# ============================================================
def info(msg): print(f"  ▶ {msg}")
def ok(msg): print(f"  ✓ {msg}")
def warn(msg): print(f"  ⚠ {msg}")
def error(msg): print(f"  ✗ {msg}")

def banner(title):
    print()
    print("=" * 50)
    print(f"  {title}")
    print("=" * 50)
    print()

def summary(total, sources):
    print()
    print("─" * 50)
    print(f"  📊 Total: {total}")
    for name, count in sources.items():
        print(f"     {name}: {count}")
    print("─" * 50)
    print()


def load_config():
    with open(CONFIG_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        return json.load(f)


def get_ssl():
    ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
    ctx.check_hostname = False
    ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
    return ctx


# ============================================================
# 金十快讯
# ============================================================
def fetch_jin10(limit=20):
    news = []
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request("https://flash.jin10.com/", headers={
            'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36',
        })
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15, context=get_ssl()) as r:
            content = r.read().decode('utf-8')
        
        ids = list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r'/detail/(\d{17,20})', content)))[:limit]
        
        for id in ids:
            try:
                req2 = urllib.request.Request(f"https://flash.jin10.com/detail/{id}",
                    headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req2, timeout=8, context=get_ssl()) as r2:
                    detail = r2.read().decode('utf-8')
                
                m = re.search(r'<title>([^<]+)</title>', detail)
                if m:
                    title = m.group(1).replace(' - 金十数据', '').strip()
                    title = re.sub(r'^【金十数据】', '', title)
                    news.append({
                        "title": title,
                        "url": f"https://flash.jin10.com/detail/{id}",
                        "source": "金十快讯",
                        "ts": time.time()
                    })
                time.sleep(0.2)
            except:
                pass
    except Exception as e:
        error(f"Jin10: {e}")
    return news


# ============================================================
# RSS 源
# ============================================================
def fetch_rss(url, name=""):
    news = []
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15, context=get_ssl()) as r:
            content = r.read().decode('utf-8')
        
        root = ET.fromstring(content)
        for item in root.findall('.//item')[:15]:
            title = (item.findtext('title') or '').strip()
            link = item.findtext('link') or ''
            
            if title and link:
                news.append({
                    "title": title,
                    "url": link,
                    "source": name or url.split('/')[2],
                    "ts": time.time()
                })
    except Exception as e:
        warn(f"{name}: {str(e)[:40]}")
    return news


# ============================================================
# 主函数
# ============================================================
def fetch_all():
    config = load_config()
    all_news = []
    sources = {}
    
    banner("NewsHub Fetcher")
    info(f"Time: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print()
    
    for key, src in config.get('news_sources', {}).items():
        if not src.get('enable', True):
            continue
        
        name = src.get('name', key)
        info(f"Fetching {name}...")
        
        if key == 'jin10':
            news = fetch_jin10(src.get('limit', 20))
        else:
            news = fetch_rss(src['url'], name)
        
        sources[name] = len(news)
        all_news.extend(news)
        
        if news:
            ok(f"{name}: +{len(news)}")
        else:
            warn(f"{name}: 0")
    
    all_news.sort(key=lambda x: x.get('ts', 0), reverse=True)
    summary(len(all_news), sources)
    
    return all_news


def show_news(news, limit=10):
    for i, n in enumerate(news[:limit], 1):
        print(f"  {i:2d}. {n['title'][:55]}...")
        print(f"       [{n.get('source', '')}]")
        print()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    news = fetch_all()
    show_news(news)

            if result.get('code') == 0:

                ok(f"{n['title'][:45]}...")
                sent += 1
            else:

            time.sleep(0.3)

"""

"""
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
from news_fetcher import fetch_all, load_config

from datetime import datetime

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 样式定义
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class Style:
    HEADER = '\033[95m'
    BLUE = '\033[94m'
    CYAN = '\033[96m'
    GREEN = '\033[92m'
    YELLOW = '\033[93m'
    RED = '\033[91m'
    BOLD = '\033[1m'
    END = '\033[0m'
    
    # 简写
    H = HEADER
    B = BLUE
    C = CYAN
    G = GREEN
    Y = YELLOW
    R = RED
    X = BOLD
    E = END

def is_colorful():
    """检测终端是否支持颜色"""
    return sys.platform != 'win32' or 'TERM' in __import__('os').environ

COLORFUL = is_colorful()

def c(style, text): return f"{style}{text}{Style.E}" if COLORFUL else text
def bold(text): return c(Style.X, text)
def red(text): return c(Style.R, text)
def green(text): return c(Style.G, text)
def yellow(text): return c(Style.Y, text)
def blue(text): return c(Style.B, text)
def cyan(text): return c(Style.C, text)

# 进度条
def progress_bar(current, total, width=30, fill='█', empty='─'):
    """显示进度条"""
    percent = current / total
    filled = int(width * percent)
    bar = fill * filled + empty * (width - filled)
    return f"[{bar}] {int(percent*100)}%"

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 输出函数
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def info(msg): print(f"  {blue('▶')} {msg}")
def ok(msg): print(f"  {green('✓')} {green(msg)}")
def warn(msg): print(f"  {yellow('⚠')} {yellow(msg)}")
def error(msg): print(f"  {red('✗')} {red(msg)}")

def banner(title, icon="📡"):
    print()
    print(c(Style.C, "╔" + "═" * 48 + "╗"))
    print(c(Style.C, "║") + f"  {icon} {bold(title)}".ljust(48) + c(Style.C, "║"))
    print(c(Style.C, "╚" + "═" * 48 + "╝"))
    print()

def sep():
    print(c(Style.C, "  " + "─" * 46))

#!/usr/bin/env python3 """ NewsHub RSS Server - 本地RSS服务 提供缓存新闻的RSS订阅 """ import sys sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8') from pathlib import Path sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent)) from news_fetcher import fetch_all, load_cache from datetime import datetime import json from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET PORT = 8888 def news_to_rss(news_list, base_url="http://localhost:8888"): """将新闻列表转换为RSS XML""" root = ET.Element('rss', version='2.0') channel = ET.SubElement(root, 'channel') # 频道信息 ET.SubElement(channel, 'title').text = 'NewsHub - 金融新闻聚合' ET.SubElement(channel, 'link').text = 'https://github.com/OpenClaw/NewsHub' ET.SubElement(channel, 'description').text = f'聚合 {len(news_list)} 条新闻' ET.SubElement(channel, 'language').text = 'zh-cn' ET.SubElement(channel, 'lastBuildDate').text = datetime.now().strftime('%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S GMT') for n in news_list[:50]: item = ET.SubElement(channel, 'item') ET.SubElement(item, 'title').text = n.get('title', '') ET.SubElement(item, 'link').text = n.get('url', '') ET.SubElement(item, 'description').text = f"来源: {n.get('source', '')}" ET.SubElement(item, 'pubDate').text = datetime.fromtimestamp(n.get('ts', 0)).strftime('%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S GMT') return '\n' + ET.tostring(root, encoding='unicode') def news_to_html(news_list): """将新闻列表转换为HTML""" html = f""" NewsHub - {len(news_list)} 条新闻

📊 NewsHub

共 {len(news_list)} 条新闻 | 更新时间: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}
📡 RSS订阅 """ for n in news_list[:30]: source = n.get('source', '') source_icon = "📰" if "新浪" in source else ("🌐" if "Investing" in source else ("📊" if "Seeking" in source else "📱")) html += f"""

{source_icon} {n.get('title', '')}

🔗 查看详情
来源: {source}
""" html += """ """ return html class NewsHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def log_message(self, format, *args): pass # 静默日志 def do_GET(self): if self.path == '/' or self.path == '/index.html': news = fetch_all(quiet=True, use_cache=True) html = news_to_html(news) self.send_response(200) self.send_header('Content-Type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8') self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(html.encode('utf-8')) elif self.path == '/news.xml' or self.path == '/rss': news = fetch_all(quiet=True, use_cache=True) rss = news_to_rss(news) self.send_response(200) self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/xml; charset=utf-8') self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*') self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(rss.encode('utf-8')) elif self.path == '/api/news': news = fetch_all(quiet=True, use_cache=True) self.send_response(200) self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json; charset=utf-8') self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(json.dumps(news, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')) elif self.path == '/api/stats': news = fetch_all(quiet=True, use_cache=True) sources = {} for n in news: s = n.get('source', 'Other') sources[s] = sources.get(s, 0) + 1 stats = {"total": len(news), "sources": sources, "time": datetime.now().isoformat()} self.send_response(200) self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json; charset=utf-8') self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(json.dumps(stats, ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')) else: self.send_response(404) self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(b'Not Found') def do_OPTIONS(self): self.send_response(200) self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*') self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET, OPTIONS') self.send_header('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type') self.end_headers() def run_server(port=PORT): server = HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', port), NewsHandler) print(f""" ╔════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ 📡 NewsHub RSS Server ║ ╚════════════════════════════════════════════════╝ 🌐 http://localhost:{port} (HTML) 📡 http://localhost:{port}/news.xml (RSS) 📊 http://localhost:{port}/api/stats (JSON) 按 Ctrl+C 停止服务 """) try: server.serve_forever() except KeyboardInterrupt: print("\n\n 👋 Server stopped") server.shutdown() if __name__ == "__main__": import argparse parser = argparse.ArgumentParser() parser.add_argument('--port', type=int, default=PORT, help='端口') args = parser.parse_args() run_server(args.port)

# NewsHub v1.4 - 金融新闻聚合推送系统

## 概述

NewsHub 是一个模块化的金融新闻聚合和推送系统，支持多源抓取、智能分类、情感分析和多渠道推送。

## 核心功能

### 多源新闻聚合
- **新浪财经** (15条) - 中国财经要闻
- **Investing.com** (10条) - 全球市场新闻
- **Seeking Alpha** (7条) - 专业投资分析
- **Reuters** (10条) - 国际财经通讯

### 智能分类
自动将新闻分类为:
- 📈 股市 (stock)
- 💱 外汇 (forex)
- 🛢️ 大宗商品 (commodity)
- 🏛️ 宏观 (macro)
- ⚖️ 贸易 (trade)
- 💻 科技 (tech)
- 🇺🇸 美国 (us)
- 🇨🇳 中国 (china)

### 情感分析
识别新闻的情感倾向:
- 🟢 利好 (positive)
- 🔴 利空 (negative)
- ⚪ 中性 (neutral)

### 多渠道推送
- **飞书**: 多种卡片格式 (摘要/日报/告警/分类/情感)
- **QQ**: NapCat 集成 (可选)
- **RSS**: 本地 RSS 服务 (端口 8888)
- **HTML**: 可视化新闻页面

## 快速开始

```bash
# 进入目录
cd D:\OpenClaw\workspace\80-PROJECTS\NewsHub

# 抓取新闻
python news_hub.py fetch

# 飞书推送
python news_hub.py feishu digest
python news_hub.py feishu compact
python news_hub.py feishu sentiment  # 情感分析
python news_hub.py feishu cat china  # 中国新闻分类

# 启动本地服务
python news_hub.py server

# 导出数据
python news_hub.py fetch --export csv
```

## 命令详解

### news_fetcher.py
```bash
python news_fetcher.py [options]

Options:
  --quick         快速模式 (仅新浪)
  --no-cache      禁用缓存
  --cache-only    仅使用缓存
  --no-dedup      禁用去重
  --export json   导出JSON
  --export csv    导出CSV
  --limit N       限制条数 (默认50)
  --cat TYPE      分类筛选 (stock/forex/commodity/macro/trade/tech/china/us)
  --sentiment S   情感筛选 (positive/negative/neutral)
  --keywords KW   关键词筛选 (逗号分隔)
  --stats         显示分类统计
```

### news_feishu.py
```bash
python news_feishu.py [command]

Commands:
  test       连接测试
  welcome    欢迎卡片
  stats      统计信息
  daily      日报推送
  digest     摘要推送 (6条)
  alert      关键词告警
  all        全部推送 (8条)
  preview    预览新闻
  compact    紧凑视图
  sentiment  情感分析推送
  cat <type> 分类推送
```

### news_hub.py (统一入口)
```bash
python news_hub.py <command>

Commands:
  fetch    抓取新闻
  feishu   飞书推送
  qq       QQ推送
  quick    快速模式
  server   启动服务
  export   导出数据
```

## 配置

### sources.json
新闻源配置，可启用/禁用各源:

# NewsHub v1.5 - 金融新闻聚合推送系统

## 概述

NewsHub 是一个模块化的金融新闻聚合和推送系统，支持多源抓取、智能分类、情感分析、重要性评分和热点检测。

## 核心功能

### 多源新闻聚合 (4源 = 47条)
- **新浪财经** (15条) - 中国财经要闻
- **Investing.com** (10条) - 全球市场新闻
- **Seeking Alpha** (7条) - 专业投资分析
- **CNBC** (15条) - 美国商业新闻

### 智能分类 (10类)
| 分类 | 图标 | 关键词示例 |
|------|------|-----------|
| 📈 股市 | stock | A股, 美股, 港股, 纳斯达克, 道琼斯 |
| 💱 外汇 | forex | 美元, 欧元, 人民币, 汇率, DXY |
| 🛢️ 大宗商品 | commodity | 黄金, 原油, 铜, 天然气, WTI |
| 🏛️ 宏观 | macro | GDP, CPI, 非农, 加息, 降息 |
| ⚖️ 贸易 | trade | 关税, 制裁, WTO, 贸易战 |
| 💻 科技 | tech | AI, 芯片, 华为, 英伟达, 特斯拉 |
| 🇺🇸 美国 | us | 特朗普, 拜登, 美联储, Fed |
| 🇨🇳 中国 | china | 央行, 发改委, 统计局 |
| ₿ 加密 | crypto | 比特币, ETH, 区块链, NFT |
| ⚡ 能源 | energy | 光伏, 风电, 锂电, 碳中和 |

### 情感分析
| 情感 | 图标 | 关键词示例 |
|------|------|-----------|
| 🟢 利好 | positive | 上涨, 增长, 利好, 突破, 新高, 强劲 |
| 🔴 利空 | negative | 下跌, 暴跌, 利空, 衰退, 危机 |
| ⚪ 中性 | neutral | (无关键词匹配) |

### 重要性评分
| 级别 | 图标 | 关键词示例 |
|------|------|-----------|
| 🔴 critical | 危机级 | 战争, 核, 制裁, 崩盘, 违约, 黑天鹅 |
| 🟠 high | 重要级 | 美联储, 加息, 降息, 央行, G20, 峰会 |
| 🟡 medium | 一般级 | 财报, GDP, CPI, 非农, 就业, 通胀 |
| ⚪ low | 轻微级 | 评论, 分析, 预计, 可能 |

### 热点检测
自动分析新闻标题，提取出现频率最高的词汇，识别当前热点话题。

## 快速开始

```bash
cd D:\OpenClaw\workspace\80-PROJECTS\NewsHub

# 抓取新闻
python news_hub.py fetch

# 飞书推送
python news_hub.py feishu digest
python news_hub.py feishu sentiment
python news_hub.py feishu cat tech

# 启动本地服务
python news_hub.py server

# 导出数据
python news_hub.py fetch --export csv
```

## 命令详解

### news_fetcher.py (核心抓取)
```bash
python news_fetcher.py [options]

Options:
  --quick          快速模式 (仅新浪)
  --no-cache       禁用缓存
  --cache-only     仅使用缓存
  --no-dedup       禁用去重
  --export json    导出JSON
  --export csv     导出CSV
  --limit N        限制条数 (默认50)
  --cat TYPE       分类筛选
  --sentiment S    情感筛选
  --keywords KW    关键词筛选 (逗号分隔)
  --importance L   重要性筛选
  --stats          显示详细统计
```

### 分类筛选示例
```bash
python news_fetcher.py --cat stock       # 股市新闻
python news_fetcher.py --cat tech        # 科技新闻
python news_fetcher.py --cat china       # 中国新闻
python news_fetcher.py --cat us          # 美国新闻
python news_fetcher.py --cat crypto      # 加密货币
python news_fetcher.py --cat energy      # 能源新闻
```

### 情感筛选示例
```bash
python news_fetcher.py --sentiment positive  # 利好新闻
python news_fetcher.py --sentiment negative  # 利空新闻
```

### 重要性筛选示例
```bash
python news_fetcher.py --importance critical  # 危机级新闻
python news_fetcher.py --importance high      # 重要级新闻
```

### 关键词筛选示例
```bash
python news_fetcher.py --keywords "黄金,原油,美联储"
python news_fetcher.py --keywords "AI,芯片,英伟达"
python news_fetcher.py --keywords "gold,oil,Fed"
```

### 组合筛选
```bash
# 美国 + 科技 + 重要
python news_fetcher.py --cat tech --importance high --limit 10 --stats
```

## 飞书推送命令

```bash
python news_feishu.py [command]

Commands:
  test       连接测试
  welcome    欢迎卡片
  stats      统计信息
  daily      日报推送
  digest     摘要推送 (6条)
  alert      关键词告警
  all        全部推送 (8条)
  preview    预览新闻
  compact    紧凑视图
  sentiment  情感分析推送
  cat <type> 分类推送
```

## 本地服务

```bash
python rss_server.py
```

访问:
- HTML: http://localhost:8888 (可视化页面)
- RSS: http://localhost:8888/news.xml

## 技术特性

1. **并行抓取** - ThreadPoolExecutor 5个线程
2. **缓存系统** - 5分钟TTL，秒级响应
3. **智能去重** - MD5哈希 + 归一化
4. **分类算法** - 关键词匹配 + 来源映射
5. **情感分析** - 正负面词汇库 (30+词)
6. **重要性评分** - 4级关键词权重
7. **热点检测** - 词频统计

## 缓存机制

- 缓存文件: `.news_cache.json`
- TTL: 5分钟
- 强制刷新: `--no-cache`

## 版本历史

| 版本 | 日期 | 功能 |
|------|------|------|
| v1.5 | 2026-03-23 | 增强分类(10类) + 重要性评分 + 热点检测 |
| v1.4 | 2026-03-23 | 分类筛选 + 情感分析 + 关键词过滤 |
| v1.3 | 2026-03-22 | 多源 + 去重 + 导出 |
| v1.2 | 2026-03-22 | 并行抓取 + 缓存 |
| v1.1 | 2026-03-22 | 飞书卡片格式优化 |
| v1.0 | 2026-03-21 | 基础功能 |

## 文件结构

```
NewsHub/
├── news_fetcher.py   # 核心抓取模块
├── news_feishu.py    # 飞书推送
├── news_to_qq.py     # QQ推送
├── news_hub.py       # 统一入口
├── rss_server.py     # RSS/HTML服务
├── sources.json      # 新闻源配置
├── config.json       # 飞书配置
├── qq_config.json    # QQ配置
└── README.md         # 本文件
```

"""
NewsHub LLM Analyzer - 本地LLM驱动的新闻分析
支持 Ollama API 和 llama.cpp GGUF 模型
"""
import json
import time
import urllib.request
import urllib.error
from pathlib import Path

# ============================================================
# 配置
# ============================================================

# Ollama 配置
OLLAMA_URL = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
OLLAMA_MODEL = "qwen2.5:1.5b"  # 可选: qwen3.5:0.8b, qwen3.5:2b

# llama.cpp 配置 (可选)
LLAMA_CPP_MODEL = r"D:\AI-Models\Qwen3.5-2B\qwen3.5-2b-fp16.gguf"

# 分析模式
USE_OLLAMA = True  # True: 使用 Ollama API, False: 使用 llama.cpp
TIMEOUT = 30  # 超时秒数

# ============================================================
# 提示词
# ============================================================

ANALYZE_PROMPT = """分析以下金融新闻的:
1. 情感 (positive/negative/neutral)
2. 影响市场 (股票/外汇/商品/宏观)
3. 紧急程度 (high/medium/low)
4. 一句话摘要

新闻: {title}

只返回JSON格式:
{{"sentiment":"positive|negative|neutral","market":"stock|forex|commodity|macro|all","urgency":"high|medium|low","summary":"简短摘要"}}
"""

SUMMARIZE_PROMPT = """用一句话总结以下新闻（最多20字）:
{title}
"""

# ============================================================
# 工具函数
# ============================================================

def get_ssl_context():
    """获取SSL上下文"""
    import ssl
    return ssl.create_default_context()

def call_ollama(prompt: str, model: str = OLLAMA_MODEL) -> str:
    """调用 Ollama API"""
    data = {
        "model": model,
        "prompt": prompt,
        "stream": False,
        "options": {
            "temperature": 0.1,
            "num_predict": 200
        }
    }
    
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        OLLAMA_URL,
        data=json.dumps(data).encode('utf-8'),
        headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
        method='POST'
    )
    
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=TIMEOUT, context=get_ssl_context()) as resp:
            result = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
            return result.get('response', '').strip()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  ⚠ Ollama错误: {e}")
        return ""

def parse_llm_response(response: str) -> dict:
    """解析LLM响应"""
    try:
        # 尝试提取JSON
        for line in response.split('\n'):
            line = line.strip()
            if line.startswith('{') and line.endswith('}'):
                return json.loads(line)
        
        # 尝试从文本中提取
        import re
        match = re.search(r'\{[^}]+\}', response)
        if match:
            return json.loads(match.group())
    except:
        pass
    return {"sentiment": "neutral", "market": "all", "urgency": "medium", "summary": ""}

# ============================================================
# 核心分析函数
# ============================================================

def analyze_news_with_llm(title: str) -> dict:
    """使用本地LLM分析单条新闻"""
    if not USE_OLLAMA:
        return {"sentiment": "neutral", "market": "all", "urgency": "medium", "summary": ""}
    
    prompt = ANALYZE_PROMPT.format(title=title)
    response = call_ollama(prompt)
    
    if response:
        return parse_llm_response(response)
    return {"sentiment": "neutral", "market": "all", "urgency": "medium", "summary": ""}

def summarize_news_with_llm(title: str) -> str:
    """使用本地LLM生成新闻摘要"""
    if not USE_OLLAMA:
        return title[:30] + "..." if len(title) > 30 else title
    
    prompt = SUMMARIZE_PROMPT.format(title=title)
    response = call_ollama(prompt, options={"num_predict": 50})
    return response.strip() if response else title[:30] + "..."

def batch_analyze(news_list: list, delay: float = 0.5) -> list:
    """批量分析新闻"""
    if not USE_OLLAMA:
        print("  ⚠ Ollama未启用，使用规则分析")
        return news_list
    
    print("  🤖 启动本地LLM分析...")
    start = time.time()
    
    results = []
    for i, news in enumerate(news_list):
        title = news.get('title', '')
        
        # 进度显示
        if i % 5 == 0:

def analyze_llm_parallel(args):
    """并行LLM分析worker"""
    idx, title = args
    result = analyze_with_llm(title)
    return idx, result

def enrich_with_llm(news_list, max_items=10):
    """使用LLM并行丰富新闻数据"""
    if not check_ollama_status():
        print("  ⚠ Ollama未运行，跳过LLM分析")
        return news_list
    
    print("  🤖 启用本地LLM并行分析...")
    start = time.time()
    
    # 准备任务
    tasks = [(i, news.get('title', '')) for i, news in enumerate(news_list[:max_items])]
    
    # 并行分析
    results = {}
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=5) as executor:
        futures = {executor.submit(analyze_llm_parallel, task): task for task in tasks}
        for i, future in enumerate(as_completed(futures)):
            idx, analysis = future.result()
            if analysis:
                results[idx] = analysis
            # 进度
            if (i + 1) % 5 == 0:
                print(f"    进度: {i+1}/{len(tasks)}")
    
    # 应用结果
    llm_count = 0
    for idx, news in enumerate(news_list[:max_items]):
        if idx in results:
            analysis = results[idx]
            news['llm_sentiment'] = analysis.get('sentiment', 'neutral')
            news['llm_summary'] = analysis.get('summary', '')
            news['llm_urgency'] = analysis.get('urgency', 'medium')
            
            # 覆盖规则分析结果
            if analysis.get('sentiment') in ['positive', 'negative']:
                news['sentiment'] = analysis['sentiment']
            llm_count += 1
    
    elapsed = time.time() - start
    print(f"  ✅ LLM分析完成: {llm_count}条 ({elapsed:.1f}s)")
    return news_list

# NewsHub v1.7 - 金融新闻聚合推送系统

## 概述

NewsHub 是一个模块化的金融新闻聚合和推送系统，支持多源抓取、智能分类、情感分析、重要性评分、热点检测和本地LLM深度分析。

## 核心功能

### 多源新闻聚合 (6源 = 67条)
| 来源 | 数量 | 类型 |
|------|------|------|
| 新浪财经 | 15 | 中文财经 |
| 东方财富 | 10 | A股资讯 |
| 同花顺 | 10 | 股市新闻 |
| Investing | 10 | 全球市场 |
| Seeking Alpha | 7 | 投资分析 |
| CNBC | 15 | 美国商业 |

### 智能分类 (10类)
📈股市 | 💱外汇 | 🛢️大宗商品 | 🏛️宏观 | ⚖️贸易 | 💻科技 | 🇺🇸美国 | 🇨🇳中国 | ₿加密 | ⚡能源

### 情感分析 + 重要性评分
- 🟢利好/🔴利空/⚪中性
- 🔴危机/🟠重要/🟡一般/⚪轻微

### 本地LLM分析 (Ollama qwen2.5:1.5b)
- 深度情感分析
- 智能摘要生成
- 紧急程度评估
- **并行处理** - 5线程并发
- **结果缓存** - MD5哈希，1小时TTL

## 快速开始

```bash
cd D:\OpenClaw\workspace\80-PROJECTS\NewsHub

# 基础抓取
python news_hub.py fetch

# LLM深度分析
python news_hub.py fetch --llm --limit 10

# 飞书推送
python news_hub.py feishu digest
python news_hub.py feishu summary
python news_hub.py feishu sentiment

# 分类筛选
python news_hub.py fetch --cat tech --stats
python news_hub.py fetch --importance critical

# 启动本地服务
python news_hub.py server
```

## 新闻源命令

```bash
python news_fetcher.py [options]

Options:
  --quick          快速模式 (仅新浪)
  --no-cache       禁用缓存
  --cache-only     仅使用缓存
  --export json    导出JSON
  --export csv     导出CSV
  --limit N        限制条数
  --cat TYPE       分类筛选
  --sentiment S    情感筛选
  --keywords KW    关键词筛选
  --importance L   重要性筛选
  --llm            使用本地LLM分析
  --stats          显示详细统计
```

## 飞书推送命令

```bash
python news_feishu.py [command]

Commands:
  test       连接测试
  welcome    欢迎卡片
  stats      统计信息
  daily      日报推送
  digest     摘要推送 (6条)
  alert      关键词告警
  all        全部推送 (8条)
  preview    预览新闻
  compact    紧凑视图
  summary    摘要卡片（统计概览）
  sentiment  情感分析推送
  cat <type> 分类推送
```

## 本地服务

```bash
python rss_server.py
```

访问:
- HTML: http://localhost:8888 (可视化页面)
- RSS: http://localhost:8888/news.xml

## Ollama 配置

### 启动 Ollama
```bash
# 方法1: 直接启动
D:\Ollama\ollama.exe serve

# 方法2: Windows服务（需管理员）
```

### 下载模型
```bash
D:\Ollama\ollama.exe pull qwen2.5:1.5b
```

### LLM缓存
- 缓存文件: `.llm_cache.json`
- 缓存TTL: 1小时
- 自动去重相同标题

## 性能优化

| 功能 | 优化 | 效果 |
|------|------|------|
| 并行抓取 | 5线程 | 1.7s抓取67条 |
| 新闻缓存 | 5分钟TTL | 秒级响应 |
| 并行LLM | 5线程并发 | 提速47% |
| LLM缓存 | MD5哈希 | 重复分析秒级 |

## 版本历史

| 版本 | 日期 | 功能 |
|------|------|------|

# NewsHub v1.8 - 金融新闻聚合推送系统

NewsHub 是一个模块化的金融新闻聚合和推送系统，支持多源抓取、智能分类、情感分析、重要性评分、热点检测、新闻聚类和本地LLM深度分析。

### 多源新闻聚合 (6源 = 67条)
| 来源 | 数量 | 类型 |
|------|------|------|
| 新浪财经 | 15 | 中文财经 |
| 东方财富 | 10 | A股资讯 |
| 同花顺 | 10 | 股市新闻 |
| Investing | 10 | 全球市场 |
| Seeking Alpha | 7 | 投资分析 |
| CNBC | 15 | 美国商业 |

### 智能分类 (10类)
📈股市 | 💱外汇 | 🛢️大宗商品 | 🏛️宏观 | ⚖️贸易 | 💻科技 | 🇺🇸美国 | 🇨🇳中国 | ₿加密 | ⚡能源

- **关键实体**: 公司/人名提取
- **投资建议**: bullish/bearish/neutral

"""
NewsHub 历史数据库 - SQLite持久化存储
"""
import sqlite3
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

DB_FILE = Path('news_history.db')

def init_db():
    """初始化数据库"""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE)
    c = conn.cursor()
    
    c.execute('''
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS news (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
            url TEXT,
            source TEXT,
            category TEXT,
            sentiment TEXT,
            sentiment_score INTEGER,
            importance TEXT,
            ts REAL,
            created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )
    ''')
    
    c.execute('''
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS daily_summary (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            date TEXT UNIQUE,
            total_news INTEGER,
            positive INTEGER,
            negative INTEGER,
            neutral INTEGER,
            top_topics TEXT,
            avg_sentiment REAL,
            data TEXT,
            created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )
    ''')
    
    c.execute('''
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS alerts (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            keyword TEXT,
            news_title TEXT,
            news_url TEXT,
            source TEXT,
            ts REAL,
            sent INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
            created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )
    ''')
    
    # 创建索引
    c.execute('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_news_ts ON news(ts)')
    c.execute('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_news_source ON news(source)')
    c.execute('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_alerts_sent ON alerts(sent)')
    
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

def save_news(news_list):
    """保存新闻到数据库"""
    if not news_list:
        return 0
    
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE)
    c = conn.cursor()
    
    saved = 0
    for n in news_list:
        try:
            c.execute('''
                INSERT OR IGNORE INTO news 
                (title, url, source, category, sentiment, sentiment_score, importance, ts)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ''', (
                n.get('title', ''),
                n.get('url', ''),
                n.get('source', ''),
                n.get('category', ''),
                n.get('sentiment', ''),
                n.get('llm_score', 0),
                n.get('importance_level', ''),
                n.get('ts', time.time())
            ))
            saved += 1
        except:
            pass
    
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return saved

def get_news(days=7, limit=100):
    """获取历史新闻"""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE)
    c = conn.cursor()
    
    since = time.time() - (days * 86400)
    
    c.execute('''
        SELECT title, url, source, category, sentiment, sentiment_score, importance, ts
        FROM news
        WHERE ts > ?
        ORDER BY ts DESC
        LIMIT ?
    ''', (since, limit))
    
    results = []
    for row in c.fetchall():
        results.append({
            'title': row[0],
            'url': row[1],
            'source': row[2],
            'category': row[3],
            'sentiment': row[4],
            'sentiment_score': row[5],
            'importance': row[6],
            'ts': row[7]
        })
    
    conn.close()
    return results

def get_daily_summary(date=None):
    """获取每日摘要"""
    if date is None:
        date = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE)
    c = conn.cursor()
    
    c.execute('SELECT * FROM daily_summary WHERE date = ?', (date,))
    row = c.fetchone()
    conn.close()
    
    if row:
        return {
            'date': row[1],
            'total': row[2],
            'positive': row[3],
            'negative': row[4],
            'neutral': row[5],
            'top_topics': json.loads(row[6]) if row[6] else [],
            'avg_sentiment': row[7],
            'data': json.loads(row[8]) if row[8] else []
        }
    return None

def save_daily_summary(date, stats, top_topics, data):
    """保存每日摘要"""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE)
    c = conn.cursor()
    
    c.execute('''
        INSERT OR REPLACE INTO daily_summary 
        (date, total_news, positive, negative, neutral, top_topics, avg_sentiment, data)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ''', (
        date,
        stats.get('total', 0),
        stats.get('positive', 0),
        stats.get('negative', 0),
        stats.get('neutral', 0),
        json.dumps(top_topics),
        stats.get('avg_sentiment', 0),
        json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False)
    ))
    
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

def get_weekly_trend(days=7):
    """获取周趋势"""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE)
    c = conn.cursor()
    
    since = time.time() - (days * 86400)
    
    c.execute('''
        SELECT 
            date(ts, 'unixepoch') as day,
            COUNT(*) as total,
            SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'positive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive,
            SUM(CASE WHEN sentiment = 'negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as negative,
            AVG(sentiment_score) as avg_score
        FROM news
        WHERE ts > ?
        GROUP BY day(ts, 'unixepoch')
        ORDER BY day DESC
    ''', (since,))
    
    results = []
    for row in c.fetchall():
        results.append({
            'date': row[0],
            'total': row[1],
            'positive': row[2],
            'negative': row[3],
            'avg_score': row[4] or 0
        })
    
    conn.close()
    return results

def get_popular_sources(days=7):
    """获取热门来源统计"""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE)
    c = conn.cursor()
    
    since = time.time() - (days * 86400)
    
    c.execute('''
        SELECT source, COUNT(*) as cnt
        FROM news
        WHERE ts > ? AND source IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY source
        ORDER BY cnt DESC
        LIMIT 10
    ''', (since,))
    
    results = [(row[0], row[1]) for row in c.fetchall()]
    conn.close()
    return results

def save_alert(keyword, news):
    """保存告警"""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE)
    c = conn.cursor()
    
    c.execute('''
        INSERT INTO alerts (keyword, news_title, news_url, source, ts)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    ''', (
        keyword,
        news.get('title', ''),
        news.get('url', ''),
        news.get('source', ''),
        time.time()
    ))
    
    alert_id = c.lastrowid
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return alert_id

def get_pending_alerts():
    """获取待发送告警"""
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE)

"""
NewsHub 智能告警系统
基于关键词规则自动检测重要新闻
"""
import re
import time
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

# 告警规则配置
ALERT_RULES = {
    # 最高级别 - 立刻告警
    'critical': [
        # 市场崩盘/危机
        r'崩盘|股灾|金融危机|黑天鹅',
        r'大跌[至迫]?[0-9]|暴跌[0-9]+%|大跌[0-9]+%',
        r'战争|冲突|袭击|恐慌',
        # 重大政策
        r'央行.*降息|降准|量化宽松',
        r'制裁.*[俄中伊朝]|禁止.*[原油|贸易]',
        # 系统性风险
        r'雷曼|贝尔斯登|硅谷银行',
    ],
    # 高级别 - 重要告警
    'high': [
        # 经济数据
        r'CPI|PPI|GDP|非农|失业率',
        r'美联储.*[加息降息]|鲍威尔',
        r'美[联储联].*利率',
        # 贸易相关
        r'关税|[贸贸]战|贸易.*[协议谈判]',
        r'Trump|Biden|习近平|拜登|特朗普',
        # 市场动态
        r'原油.*[涨跌]|黄金.*[涨跌]|油价',
        r'科技股|互联网|半导体|AI.*[突破进展]',
    ],
    # 中级别 - 关注
    'medium': [
        # 公司财报
        r'财报|业绩|[盈亏]利|营收',
        r'特斯拉|苹果|谷歌|亚马逊|英伟达|华为',
        # 行业动态
        r'新能源|锂电|光伏|医药|白酒',
        # 外汇
        r'美元.*[涨跌]|人民币.*[贬值升值]|汇率',
    ],
    # 普通告警
    'low': [
        # 市场情绪
        r'恐慌|贪婪|观望',
        r'突破|支撑|压力',
    ]
}

# 关键词白名单 (降低噪音)
WHITELIST = [
    r'涨停|连板|[涨升]停',
    r'回购|[增减持]',
    r'调研|机构.*[买入推荐]'
]

def match_alert(title, rules):
    """检查标题是否匹配告警规则"""
    for rule in rules:
        if re.search(rule, title, re.IGNORECASE):
            return True
    return False

def classify_alert(title):
    """分类告警级别"""
    # 检查白名单
    if match_alert(title, WHITELIST):
        return None  # 白名单项不告警
    
    # 按优先级检查
    for level, rules in ALERT_RULES.items():
        if match_alert(title, rules):
            return level
    
    return None

def analyze_news(news_list, min_level='low'):
    """分析新闻列表，返回告警"""
    alerts = {
        'critical': [],
        'high': [],
        'medium': [],
        'low': []
    }
    
    levels = ['critical', 'high', 'medium', 'low']
    min_idx = levels.index(min_level) if min_level in levels else 0
    
    for news in news_list:
        title = news.get('title', '')
        level = classify_alert(title)
        
        if level and level in levels and levels.index(level) >= min_idx:
            alerts[level].append({
                'title': title,
                'url': news.get('url', ''),
                'source': news.get('source', ''),
                'category': news.get('category', ''),
                'time': news.get('ts', time.time())
            })
    
    return alerts

def format_alert_message(alerts, max_per_level=3):
    """格式化告警消息"""
    messages = []
    
    if alerts['critical']:
        messages.append("\n🔴 【最高级别告警】")
        for a in alerts['critical'][:max_per_level]:
            messages.append(f"   ⚠️ {a['title'][:40]}...")
    
    if alerts['high']:
        messages.append("\n🟠 【重要告警】")
        for a in alerts['high'][:max_per_level]:
            messages.append(f"   ⚡ {a['title'][:40]}...")
    
    if alerts['medium']:
        messages.append("\n🟡 【关注】")
        for a in alerts['medium'][:max_per_level]:
            messages.append(f"   📌 {a['title'][:40]}...")
    
    if alerts['low']:
        messages.append("\n⚪ 【普通】")
        for a in alerts['low'][:max_per_level]:
            messages.append(f"   • {a['title'][:40]}...")
    
    return '\n'.join(messages) if messages else ""

def generate_alert_card(alerts):
    """生成飞书告警卡片"""
    total = sum(len(v) for v in alerts.values())
    
    if total == 0:
        return None
    
    elements = [
        {
            "tag": "markdown",
            "content": f"**🚨 智能告警 ({total}条)**\n今日共检测到 {total} 条重要新闻"
        }
    ]
    
    # 最高级别
    if alerts['critical']:
        elements.append({"tag": "hr"})
        elements.append({"tag": "markdown", "content": "### 🔴 最高级别"})
        for a in alerts['critical'][:3]:
            elements.append({
                "tag": "markdown", 
                "content": f"• [{a['title'][:30]}...]({a['url']})\n  📍{a['source']}"
            })
    
    # 高级别
    if alerts['high']:
        elements.append({"tag": "hr"})
        elements.append({"tag": "markdown", "content": "### 🟠 重要"})
        for a in alerts['high'][:5]:
            elements.append({
                "tag": "markdown",
                "content": f"• [{a['title'][:30]}...]({a['url']})\n  📍{a['source']}"
            })
    
    # 中级别
    if alerts['medium']:
        elements.append({"tag": "hr"})
        elements.append({"tag": "markdown", "content": "### 🟡 关注"})
        for a in alerts['medium'][:5]:
            elements.append({
                "tag": "markdown",
                "content": f"• [{a['title'][:30]}...]({a['url']})"
            })
    
    return {"elements": elements}

def get_alert_summary(alerts):
    """获取告警摘要"""
    summary = []
    
    if alerts['critical']:
        summary.append(f"🔴 最高:{len(alerts['critical'])}")
    if alerts['high']:
        summary.append(f"🟠 重要:{len(alerts['high'])}")
    if alerts['medium']:
        summary.append(f"🟡 关注:{len(alerts['medium'])}")
    
    return ' '.join(summary) if summary else "✅ 无告警"

# 测试
if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_news = [
        {'title': '美联储宣布降息50个基点', 'url': 'https://example.com/1', 'source': 'CNBC'},
        {'title': '特朗普关税政策引发市场恐慌', 'url': 'https://example.com/2', 'source': 'Investing'},
        {'title': '英伟达发布新一代AI芯片', 'url': 'https://example.com/3', 'source': 'Seeking Alpha'},
        {'title': '黄金价格突破2000美元', 'url': 'https://example.com/4', 'source': 'Investing'},
        {'title': '苹果发布财报超预期', 'url': 'https://example.com/5', 'source': 'CNBC'},
    ]
    
    alerts = analyze_news(test_news)
    
    print("=" * 50)
    print("  智能告警测试")
    print("=" * 50)
    print(format_alert_message(alerts))
    print()
    print("摘要:", get_alert_summary(alerts))

input.content:
# NewsHub v1.9 - 金融新闻聚合推送系统

## 概述

NewsHub 是一个模块化的金融新闻聚合和推送系统，支持多源抓取、智能分类、情感分析、重要性评分、热点检测、新闻聚类、本地LLM深度分析和智能告警。

## 核心功能

### 多源新闻聚合 (6源 = 67条)
| 来源 | 数量 | 类型 |
|------|------|------|
| 新浪财经 | 15 | 中文财经 |
| 东方财富 | 10 | A股资讯 |
| 同花顺 | 10 | 股市新闻 |
| Investing | 10 | 全球市场 |
| Seeking Alpha | 7 | 投资分析 |
| CNBC | 15 | 美国商业 |

### 智能分类 (10类)
📈股市 | 💱外汇 | 🛢️大宗商品 | 🏛️宏观 | ⚖️贸易 | 💻科技 | 🇺🇸美国 | 🇨🇳中国 | ₿加密 | ⚡能源

### LLM深度分析 (Ollama qwen2.5:1.5b)
- **情感分数**: -100到+100
- **市场影响**: 股市/外汇/商品/债市/加密
- **关键实体**: 公司/人名提取
- **投资建议**: bullish/bearish/neutral
- **并行处理**: 5线程并发
- **结果缓存**: MD5哈希，1小时TTL

### 智能告警 (4级)
| 级别 | 关键词示例 | 描述 |
|------|-----------|------|
| 🔴 critical | 崩盘/危机/crash/tariff | 最高级别，立刻告警 |
| 🟠 high | 降息/CPI/Trump/Nvidia | 重要，需要关注 |
| 🟡 medium | 财报/科技股/earnings | 中等，普通关注 |
| ⚪ low | 突破/支撑/fear/greed | 普通告警 |

### 历史数据库 (SQLite)
- 新闻持久化存储
- 每日/每周趋势分析
- 来源统计

### 每日简报 (HTML/MD)
- 可视化仪表盘
- 分类统计
- 热点话题
- 新闻列表

## 快速开始

```bash
cd D:\OpenClaw\workspace\80-PROJECTS\NewsHub

# 基础抓取
python news_hub.py fetch

# 智能告警
python news_feishu.py smart

# 生成简报
python news_hub.py report

# LLM深度分析
python news_hub.py fetch --llm --limit 10

# 新闻聚类
python news_hub.py fetch --cluster --limit 30
```

## 新闻源命令

```bash
python news_fetcher.py [options]

Options:
  --quick          快速模式
  --no-cache       禁用缓存
  --llm            使用本地LLM分析
  --cluster        显示新闻聚类
  --stats          详细统计
  --limit N        限制条数
  --cat TYPE       分类筛选
  --sentiment S    情感筛选
  --importance L   重要性筛选
  --keywords KW    关键词筛选
  --export json    导出JSON
  --export csv     导出CSV
```

## 飞书推送命令

```bash
python news_feishu.py [command]

Commands:
  test       连接测试
  welcome    欢迎卡片
  stats      统计信息
  daily      日报推送
  digest     摘要推送
  alert      关键词告警
  all        全部推送
  preview    预览
  compact    紧凑视图
  summary    摘要卡片
  sentiment  情感分析
  cat <type> 分类推送
  smart      智能告警 ⭐
```

## 智能告警功能

```bash
# 智能告警
python news_feishu.py smart

# 基于关键词规则自动检测重要新闻
# 支持中英文关键词
# 4级告警: critical > high > medium > low
```

### 告警规则 (中英文)

**🔴 最高级别:**
- 市场危机: `崩盘|股灾|crash|plunge|war|conflict`
- 重大政策: `降息|QE|sanction|FED cut`

**🟠 重要:**
- 经济数据: `CPI|GDP|非农|Powell`
- 贸易: `关税|tariff|trade war|Trump`
- 市场: `油价|oil|Nvidia|科技股`

**🟡 关注:**
- 财报: `earnings|revenue|profit`
- 行业: `EV|solar|新能源`
- 外汇: `美元|forex|汇率`

## 数据库命令

```bash
# 初始化/查看数据库
python news_hub.py db

# 生成每日简报
python news_hub.py report
```

## 本地服务

```bash
python news_hub.py server
```

访问:
- HTML: http://localhost:8888
- RSS: http://localhost:8888/news.xml

## Ollama 配置

### 启动
```bash
D:\Ollama\ollama.exe serve
```

### 下载模型
```bash
D:\Ollama\ollama.exe pull qwen2.5:1.5b
```

## 性能

| 功能 | 指标 |
|------|------|
| 并行抓取 | 2.4s (6源67条) |
| LLM分析 | ~17s (5条) |
| LLM缓存 | 秒级 (重复) |
| 新闻缓存 | 5分钟TTL |
| 智能告警 | <1s |

## 版本历史

| 版本 | 日期 | 功能 |
|------|------|------|
| v1.9 | 2026-03-23 | 智能告警 + 历史数据库 + 简报生成 |
| v1.8 | 2026-03-23 | 新闻聚类 + LLM多维分析 |
| v1.7 | 2026-03-23 | 并行LLM + 东方财富 + 缓存 |
| v1.6 | 2026-03-23 | 本地LLM分析 |
| v1.5 | 2026-03-23 | 增强分类 + 重要性评分 |
| v1.4 | 2026-03-23 | 分类筛选 + 情感分析 |
| v1.3 | 2026-03-22 | 多源 + 去重 + 导出 |
| v1.0 | 2026-03-21 | 基础功能 |

import json
from pathlib import Path

from collections import defaultdict
import sys
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')

    """从SQLite数据库加载历史数据"""
    try:
        from news_db import get_news, get_weekly_trend, get_popular_sources
        news = get_news(days=days)
        trends = get_weekly_trend(days=days)
        sources = get_popular_sources(days=days)
        return news, trends, sources
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"DB Error: {e}")
        return [], [], []

def analyze_sentiment_trend(news_list):
    """分析情感趋势"""
    if not news_list:
        return {"positive": 0, "negative": 0, "neutral": 0, "score": 0}
    
    positive = sum(1 for n in news_list if n.get('sentiment') == 'positive')
    negative = sum(1 for n in news_list if n.get('sentiment') == 'negative')
    neutral = sum(1 for n in news_list if n.get('sentiment') == 'neutral')
    
    scores = [n.get('sentiment_score', 0) for n in news_list]
    avg_score = sum(scores) / len(scores) if scores else 0
    
    return {
        "positive": positive,
        "negative": negative,
        "neutral": neutral,
        "score": avg_score,
        "total": len(news_list)
    }

def analyze_category_trend(news_list):
    """分析分类趋势"""
    cats = defaultdict(int)
    for n in news_list:
        cat = n.get('category', 'other')
        cats[cat] += 1
    
    return dict(sorted(cats.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]))

def analyze_source_trend(news_list):
    """分析来源趋势"""
    sources = defaultdict(int)
    for n in news_list:
        src = n.get('source', 'Other')
        sources[src] += 1
    
    return dict(sorted(sources.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]))

    """分析重要性趋势"""
    imps = defaultdict(int)
    for n in news_list:
        imp = n.get('importance', 'low')
        imps[imp] += 1
    
    return dict(imps)

    lines = []
    lines.append("=" * 50)
    lines.append("  NewsHub 趋势分析")
    lines.append("=" * 50)
    
    # 情绪
    total = sentiment.get('total', 0)
    if total > 0:
        pos_pct = sentiment['positive'] / total * 100
        neg_pct = sentiment['negative'] / total * 100
        score = sentiment['score']
        
        lines.append(f"\n📊 情绪趋势:")
        lines.append(f"   总数: {total} | 🟢 {sentiment['positive']} ({pos_pct:.0f}%) | 🔴 {sentiment['negative']} ({neg_pct:.0f}%) | ⚪ {sentiment['neutral']}")
        lines.append(f"   情绪分数: {score:+.1f}")
        
        if score > 15:
            lines.append("   趋势: 📈 偏多")
        elif score < -15:
            lines.append("   趋势: 📉 偏空")
        else:
            lines.append("   趋势: ➡️ 中性")
    
    # 分类

        top_cats = list(categories.items())[:5]

            pct = cnt / total * 100 if total > 0 else 0
            bar = "█" * int(pct / 5)
            lines.append(f"   {cat}: {cnt} ({pct:.0f}%) {bar}")
    
    # 来源
    if sources:
        lines.append(f"\n📰 来源分布:")
        top_src = list(sources.items())[:5]
        for src, cnt in top_src:
            pct = cnt / total * 100 if total > 0 else 0
            lines.append(f"   {src}: {cnt} ({pct:.0f}%)")
    
    # 重要性
    if importance:
        lines.append(f"\n⚡ 重要性:")
        for level in ['critical', 'high', 'medium', 'low']:
            cnt = importance.get(level, 0)
            icon = "🔴" if level == "critical" else ("🟠" if level == "high" else ("🟡" if level == "medium" else "⚪"))
            lines.append(f"   {icon} {level}: {cnt}")
    
    return '\n'.join(lines)

def generate_trend_chart(trends, days=7):
    """生成简易ASCII趋势图"""
    if not trends:
        return ""
    
    lines = []
    lines.append("\n📈 周趋势图:")
    lines.append("─" * 50)
    
    for d in trends[-days:]:
        date = d['date'][-5:] if d['date'] else "??"
        total = d['total']
        score = d['avg_score']
        
        # 情绪指示
        if score > 10:
            mood = "🟢"
        elif score < -10:
            mood = "🔴"
        else:
            mood = "⚪"
        
        # 简易柱状图
        bar_len = min(total // 2, 20)
        bar = "▓" * bar_len
        
        lines.append(f"{date} {mood} {bar} {total}")
    
    lines.append("─" * 50)
    return '\n'.join(lines)

            {"tag": "hr"},

        ]
    }

    card["elements"].append({"tag": "hr"})
    card["elements"].append({"tag": "markdown", "content": "**⚡ 重要性:**"})
    
    for level in ['critical', 'high', 'medium', 'low']:
        cnt = importance.get(level, 0)
        icon = "🔴" if level == "critical" else ("🟠" if level == "high" else ("🟡" if level == "medium" else "⚪"))
        card["elements"].append({"tag": "markdown", "content": f"{icon} {level}: {cnt}"})
    
    return card, text

def compare_periods(news_old, news_new):
    """对比两个时期的新闻"""
    old_titles = {n.get('title', '') for n in news_old}
    new_titles = {n.get('title', '') for n in news_new}
    
    # 新增新闻
    new_items = [n for n in news_new if n.get('title', '') not in old_titles]
    
    # 消失的新闻

        "new_count": len(new_items),
        "new_news": new_items[:10],
        "gone_count": len(old_items),
        "gone_news": old_items[:10]
    }

    """主函数"""

# NewsHub v2.0 - 金融新闻聚合推送系统

## 概述

NewsHub 是一个模块化的金融新闻聚合和推送系统，支持多源抓取、智能分类、情感分析、重要性评分、热点检测、新闻聚类、本地LLM深度分析、智能告警和关键词订阅。

## 核心功能

### 多源新闻聚合 (6源 = 67条)
| 来源 | 数量 | 类型 |
|------|------|------|
| 新浪财经 | 15 | 中文财经 |
| 东方财富 | 10 | A股资讯 |
| 同花顺 | 10 | 股市新闻 |
| Investing | 10 | 全球市场 |
| Seeking Alpha | 7 | 投资分析 |
| CNBC | 15 | 美国商业 |

### 智能分类 (10类)
📈股市 | 💱外汇 | 🛢️大宗商品 | 🏛️宏观 | ⚖️贸易 | 💻科技 | 🇺🇸美国 | 🇨🇳中国 | ₿加密 | ⚡能源

### LLM深度分析 (Ollama qwen2.5:1.5b)
- **情感分数**: -100到+100
- **市场影响**: 股市/外汇/商品/债市/加密
- **关键实体**: 公司/人名提取
- **投资建议**: bullish/bearish/neutral
- **并行处理**: 5线程并发
- **结果缓存**: MD5哈希，1小时TTL

### 智能告警 (4级)
| 级别 | 关键词示例 | 描述 |
|------|-----------|------|
| 🔴 critical | 崩盘/危机/crash/tariff/FED | 最高级别，立刻告警 |
| 🟠 high | CPI/Trump/Nvidia/关税 | 重要，需要关注 |
| 🟡 medium | 财报/earnings/EV/新能源 | 中等，普通关注 |
| ⚪ low | 突破/breakout/fear | 普通告警 |

### 关键词订阅 ⭐
自定义关键词订阅，匹配时自动推送
- 14个默认关键词
- 支持中英文
- 4级告警分类
- 模糊匹配支持

### 趋势分析 ⭐
- 情绪趋势
- 分类分布
- 重要性分布
- 周趋势图

## 快速开始

```bash
cd D:\OpenClaw\workspace\80-PROJECTS\NewsHub

# 基础抓取
python news_hub.py fetch

# 关键词监控
python news_hub.py watch

# 趋势分析
python news_hub.py trends

# 订阅管理
python news_hub.py sub list
python news_hub.py sub add "比特币" high
python news_hub.py sub remove "比特币"

# 生成简报
python news_hub.py report

# 智能告警
python news_hub.py feishu smart
```

## 命令列表

### 主命令
| 命令 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| `fetch` | 抓取新闻 |
| `feishu` | 飞书推送 |
| `qq` | QQ推送 |
| `quick` | 快速模式 |
| `export` | 导出新闻 |
| `server` | RSS服务 |
| `report` | 生成简报 |
| `db` | 数据库 |
| `trends` | 趋势分析 |
| `sub` | 订阅管理 |
| `watch` | 关键词监控 |
| `test` | 测试连接 |

### 飞书子命令
| 命令 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| `compact` | 紧凑视图 |
| `preview` | 预览 |
| `digest` | 摘要推送 |
| `alert` | 关键词告警 |
| `all` | 全部推送 |
| `daily` | 日报 |
| `stats` | 统计 |
| `summary` | 摘要卡片 |
| `sentiment` | 情感分析 |
| `cat <type>` | 分类推送 |
| `smart` | 智能告警 |
| `test` | 测试 |

## 订阅管理

```bash
# 列出所有订阅
python news_hub.py sub list

# 添加订阅
python news_hub.py sub add "关键词" [critical|high|medium|low]

# 移除订阅
python news_hub.py sub remove "关键词"

# 检查匹配
python news_hub.py watch
```

### 默认订阅关键词
```
🔴 critical: 降息, FED, tariff
🟠 high:     涨停, Nvidia, CPI, Trump
🟡 medium:   人民币, Tesla, AI, 原油, 黄金, oil, gold
```

## 趋势分析

```bash
# 分析最近7天趋势
python news_hub.py trends

# 分析最近30天趋势
python news_hub.py trends 30
```

输出示例:
```
[SENTIMENT]
  Total: 69 | + 4 (6%) | - 1 (1%)
  Score: +0.0 | Trend: =

[CATEGORIES]
  other: 52 (75%) ###############
  tech: 5 (7%) #

[WEEKLY TREND]
03-23 [=] ############### 69
```

## 定时任务 (Windows)

创建定时任务:
```batch
schtasks /create /sc daily /st 08:00 /tr "D:\OpenClaw\workspace\80-PROJECTS\NewsHub\daily.bat"
schtasks /create /sc daily /st 12:00 /tr "D:\OpenClaw\workspace\80-PROJECTS\NewsHub\daily.bat"
schtasks /create /sc daily /st 18:00 /tr "D:\OpenClaw\workspace\80-PROJECTS\NewsHub\daily.bat"
```

## 文件结构

```
NewsHub/
├── news_fetcher.py       # 核心抓取
├── news_feishu.py        # 飞书推送
├── news_alerts.py        # 智能告警
├── news_db.py            # 历史数据库
├── news_report.py        # 简报生成
├── news_trends.py        # 趋势分析 ⭐
├── news_subscriptions.py # 关键词订阅 ⭐
├── news_hub.py           # 统一入口

├── news_history.db      # SQLite数据库
└── README.md
```

## 性能

| 功能 | 指标 |
|------|------|
| 并行抓取 | 2.4s (6源67条) |
| LLM分析 | ~17s (5条) |
| LLM缓存 | 秒级 (重复) |
| 新闻缓存 | 5分钟TTL |
| 智能告警 | <1s |
| 趋势分析 | <0.1s |

| 版本 | 日期 | 功能 |

| v1.9 | 2026-03-23 | 智能告警 + 历史数据库 + 简报生成 |
| v1.8 | 2026-03-23 | 新闻聚类 + LLM多维分析 |
| v1.7 | 2026-03-23 | 并行LLM + 东方财富 + 缓存 |

| v1.5 | 2026-03-23 | 增强分类 + 重要性评分 |
| v1.4 | 2026-03-23 | 分类筛选 + 情感分析 |
| v1.3 | 2026-03-22 | 多源 + 去重 + 导出 |
| v1.0 | 2026-03-21 | 基础功能 |

import time
import ssl

import urllib.error

from datetime import datetime

# 配置
# ============================================================

class Config:
    # Ollama 配置
    OLLAMA_URL = "http://localhost:11434/api/generate"

    # 可用模型列表
    AVAILABLE_MODELS = [
        ("qwen2.5:1.5b", "Qwen 1.5B (快速)"),

        ("llama3.2:1b", "Llama 3.2 1B (快速)"),

    ]
    
    # 分析选项
    TIMEOUT = 30
    MAX_TOKENS = 200

{{"sentiment":"","score":0,"markets":[],"urgency":"","timeframe":"","entities":[],"keywords":[],"risk_level":"","action":"","summary":""}}"""

- title: 原标题
- sentiment: 情感
- score: 分数 (-100到+100)
- markets: 影响市场
- urgency: 紧急程度
- summary: 摘要

"""

1. overall_sentiment: 整体情绪 (bullish/bearish/neutral)

5. outlook: 短期展望

纯JSON:
"""

# ============================================================
# SSL上下文
# ============================================================

def get_ssl_context():
    """获取SSL上下文"""
    ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
    ctx.check_hostname = False
    ctx.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE
    return ctx

# ============================================================
# Ollama API 调用
# ============================================================

def call_ollama(prompt: str, model: str = None, options: dict = None) -> str:
    """调用Ollama API"""
    url = Config.OLLAMA_URL
    model = model or Config.OLLAMA_MODEL
    
    data = {
        "model": model,
        "prompt": prompt,
        "stream": Config.STREAM,
        "options": {
            "num_predict": Config.MAX_TOKENS,
            "temperature": Config.TEMPERATURE,
            "stop": ["```", "\n\n"]
        }
    }
    
    if options:
        data["options"].update(options)
    
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url,
            data=json.dumps(data).encode('utf-8'),
            headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
            method='POST'
        )
        
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=Config.TIMEOUT, context=get_ssl_context()) as resp:
            result = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
            return result.get('response', '')
    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"    ⚠ LLM调用失败: {e}")
        return ''

def check_ollama_status() -> dict:
    """检查Ollama状态"""
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            "http://localhost:11434/api/tags",
            headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
        )
        
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5, context=get_ssl_context()) as resp:
            result = json.loads(resp.read().decode('utf-8'))
            models = [m['name'] for m in result.get('models', [])]
            return {"status": "ok", "models": models}
    
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "error", "error": str(e)}

def list_available_models() -> list:
    """列出可用模型"""
    status = check_ollama_status()
    if status["status"] == "ok":
        return status["models"]
    return []

# ============================================================
# 分析函数
# ============================================================

def analyze_news_deep(title: str, model: str = None) -> dict:
    """深度分析单条新闻"""
    prompt = DEEP_ANALYZE_PROMPT.format(title=title)
    response = call_ollama(prompt, model)
    
    if response:
        try:
            # 提取JSON
            json_str = extract_json(response)
            if json_str:
                result = json.loads(json_str)
                # 验证并补充默认值
                return validate_analysis_result(result)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            pass
    
    return get_default_analysis()

def analyze_news_batch(news_list: list, model: str = None) -> list:
    """批量分析新闻（并行）"""
    available_models = list_available_models()
    if not available_models:
        print("  ⚠ Ollama未运行，请先启动:")
        print("     D:\Ollama\ollama.exe serve")
        return news_list
    
    print(f"  🤖 启动LLM分析 ({len(news_list)}条, 模型: {Config.OLLAMA_MODEL})...")
    start = time.time()
    
    def process(news):
        title = news.get('title', '')
        result = analyze_news_deep(title, model)
        
        # 合并结果
        news['llm_sentiment'] = result.get('sentiment', 'neutral')
        news['llm_score'] = result.get('score', 0)
        news['llm_markets'] = result.get('markets', [])
        news['llm_urgency'] = result.get('urgency', 'medium')
        news['llm_timeframe'] = result.get('timeframe', 'short')
        news['llm_entities'] = result.get('entities', [])
        news['llm_keywords'] = result.get('keywords', [])
        news['llm_risk'] = result.get('risk_level', 'low')
        news['llm_action'] = result.get('action', 'watch')
        news['llm_summary'] = result.get('summary', '')
        news['llm_ts'] = time.time()
        
        # 更新基础字段
        if result.get('sentiment') in ['positive', 'negative']:
            news['sentiment'] = result['sentiment']
        
        return news
    
    # 并行处理
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=Config.MAX_WORKERS) as executor:
        results = list(executor.map(process, news_list))
    
    elapsed = time.time() - start
    print(f"  ✅ LLM分析完成: {len(results)}条 ({elapsed:.1f}s)")
    print(f"  📊 平均: {elapsed/len(results):.2f}s/条")

def cmd_sentiment_market():
    """发送LLM市场情绪分析"""
    from news_fetcher import fetch_all, get_market_sentiment
    
    banner("市场情绪", "📊")
    all_news = fetch_all(quiet=True)
    
    info(f"新闻: {len(all_news)} 条")
    
    # 检查是否有LLM分析数据
    llm_news = [n for n in all_news if n.get('llm_sentiment')]
    
    if not llm_news:
        # 需要先运行LLM分析
        info("需要先运行LLM分析...")
        from news_fetcher import enrich_with_llm
        all_news = enrich_with_llm(all_news, max_items=min(20, len(all_news)))
        llm_news = all_news
    
    sentiment = get_market_sentiment(llm_news)
    
    if not sentiment:
        warn("无法获取情绪数据")
        return 0
    
    info(f"情绪: {sentiment.get('overall', 'neutral')}")
    
    print()
    print(C("  ┌─ 市场情绪 ────────────────────────────────┐"))
    overall = sentiment.get('overall', 'neutral')
    icons = {'bullish': '📈', 'bearish': '📉', 'neutral': '➡️'}
    print(C("  │") + f"  {icons.get(overall, '➡️')} 整体: {overall.upper()}")
    print(C("  │") + f"  📈 利好: {sentiment.get('positive', 0)} | 📉 利空: {sentiment.get('negative', 0)} | ⚪ 中性: {sentiment.get('neutral', 0)}")
    print(C("  │") + f"  📊 分数: {sentiment.get('avg_score', 0):+.1f}")
    
    # 市场分布
    markets = sentiment.get('markets', {})
    if markets:
        print(C("  │"))
        print(C("  │") + "  📊 市场分布:")
        for mkt, cnt in sorted(markets.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:5]:
            print(C("  │") + f"    • {mkt}: {cnt}")
    
    # 投资建议
    advice = sentiment.get('advice', {})
    if advice:
        print(C("  │"))
        print(C("  │") + "  💡 建议分布:")
        advice_names = {'bullish': '买入', 'bearish': '卖出', 'neutral': '观望'}
        for adv, cnt in sorted(advice.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
            print(C("  │") + f"    • {advice_names.get(adv, adv)}: {cnt}")
    
    print(C("  └" + "─" * 46 + "┘"))
    print()
    
    # 发送飞书卡片
    token = get_access_token()
    if not token:
        error("认证失败")
        return 0
    
    feishu = load_feishu_config()
    card = build_market_sentiment_card(sentiment, llm_news[:10])
    result = send_card(token, feishu.get('default_receive_id', ''), card)
    
    if result.get('code') == 0:
        ok("市场情绪已发送")
        add_log('market_sentiment', 1, len(llm_news))
        return 1
    else:
        error(f"发送失败: {result.get('msg', 'Unknown')}")
        return 0

def build_market_sentiment_card(sentiment, news_list):
    """构建市场情绪卡片"""
    overall = sentiment.get('overall', 'neutral')
    icons = {'bullish': '📈', 'bearish': '📉', 'neutral': '➡️'}
    colors = {'bullish': 'green', 'bearish': 'red', 'neutral': 'grey'}
    
    elements = [
        {"tag": "markdown", "content": f"**{icons.get(overall, '➡️')} 市场情绪分析**"},
        {"tag": "markdown", "content": f"**整体趋势:** {overall.upper()}"},
        {"tag": "markdown", "content": f"**情绪分数:** {sentiment.get('avg_score', 0):+.1f}"},
        {"tag": "hr"},
        {"tag": "markdown", "content": "**📊 情感分布:**"},
        {"tag": "markdown", "content": f"🟢 利好: {sentiment.get('positive', 0)} | 🔴 利空: {sentiment.get('negative', 0)} | ⚪ 中性: {sentiment.get('neutral', 0)}"},
    ]
    
    # 市场分布
    markets = sentiment.get('markets', {})
    if markets:
        elements.append({"tag": "hr"})
        elements.append({"tag": "markdown", "content": "**📊 市场分布:**"})
        market_names = {'stock': '📈 股市', 'forex': '💱 外汇', 'commodity': '🛢️ 大宗商品', 'crypto': '₿ 加密', 'bond': '📉 债券', 'realestate': '🏠 房地产'}
        for mkt, cnt in sorted(markets.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:5]:
            name = market_names.get(mkt, mkt)
            elements.append({"tag": "markdown", "content": f"{name}: {cnt}"})
    
    # 投资建议
    advice = sentiment.get('advice', {})
    if advice:
        elements.append({"tag": "hr"})
        elements.append({"tag": "markdown", "content": "**💡 建议分布:**"})
        advice_names = {'bullish': '📈 买入', 'bearish': '📉 卖出', 'neutral': '➡️ 观望'}
        for adv, cnt in sorted(advice.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
            name = advice_names.get(adv, adv)
            elements.append({"tag": "markdown", "content": f"{name}: {cnt}"})
    
    # 最新分析新闻
    if news_list:
        elements.append({"tag": "hr"})
        elements.append({"tag": "markdown", "content": "**📰 最新分析:**"})
        for n in news_list[:5]:
            score = n.get('llm_score', 0)
            sentiment_icon = '🟢' if n.get('llm_sentiment') == 'positive' else ('🔴' if n.get('llm_sentiment') == 'negative' else '⚪')
            elements.append({
                "tag": "markdown",
                "content": f"{sentiment_icon} [{score:+d}] [{n.get('title', '')[:25]}...]({n.get('url', '')})"
            })
    
    elements.append({"tag": "hr"})
    elements.append({"tag": "div", "text": {"tag": "lark_md", "content": "🤖 NewsHub LLM情绪分析"}})
    
    return {"elements": elements}

def cmd_summary():

# NewsHub v2.1 - 金融新闻聚合推送系统

## 概述

NewsHub 是一个模块化的金融新闻聚合和推送系统，支持多源抓取、智能分类、情感分析、LLM深度分析、智能告警、关键词订阅和市场情绪分析。

## 核心功能

### 多源新闻聚合 (6源 = 67条)
| 来源 | 数量 | 类型 |
|------|------|------|
| 新浪财经 | 15 | 中文财经 |
| 东方财富 | 10 | A股资讯 |
| 同花顺 | 10 | 股市新闻 |
| Investing | 10 | 全球市场 |
| Seeking Alpha | 7 | 投资分析 |
| CNBC | 15 | 美国商业 |

### LLM深度分析 (v2.0) ⭐
**多维度分析:**
- **情感分数**: -100到+100
- **市场影响**: 股市/外汇/商品/加密/债券/房地产
- **关键实体**: 公司/人名提取
- **紧急程度**: critical/high/medium/low
- **时间范围**: immediate/short/medium/long
- **风险等级**: high/medium/low
- **投资建议**: buy/sell/hold/watch
- **一句话摘要**: <30字

**性能优化:**
- 并行处理: 5线程并发
- 结果缓存: MD5哈希，1小时TTL
- 平均速度: ~2s/条

### 市场情绪分析 ⭐
基于LLM分析结果计算整体市场情绪:
- **bullish/bearish/neutral**: 整体趋势
- **市场分布**: 各市场新闻占比
- **建议分布**: 买入/卖出/观望比例

### 智能告警 (4级)
| 级别 | 关键词示例 |
|------|-----------|
| 🔴 critical | 崩盘/危机/crash/FED降息 |
| 🟠 high | CPI/Trump/Nvidia/关税 |
| 🟡 medium | 财报/earnings/EV |
| ⚪ low | 突破/breakout/fear |

### 关键词订阅
自定义关键词，14个默认关键词:
- `🔴 critical`: 降息, FED, tariff
- `🟠 high`: 涨停, Nvidia, CPI, Trump
- `🟡 medium`: 人民币, Tesla, AI, 原油, gold

## 快速开始

```bash
cd D:\OpenClaw\workspace\80-PROJECTS\NewsHub

# 基础抓取
python news_hub.py fetch

# LLM深度分析
python news_hub.py fetch --llm --limit 10

# 市场情绪分析
python news_hub.py fetch --llm --stats

# 飞书推送
python news_hub.py feishu market
python news_hub.py feishu smart
python news_hub.py feishu digest
```

## 命令列表

### 主命令
```bash
python news_hub.py <command>

fetch      抓取新闻
feishu     飞书推送
quick      快速模式
export     导出新闻
report     生成简报
db         数据库
trends     趋势分析
sub        订阅管理
watch      关键词监控
```

### 飞书推送子命令
```bash
python news_hub.py feishu <mode>

compact    紧凑视图
digest     摘要推送
smart      智能告警
market     市场情绪 ⭐
all        全部推送
stats      统计
summary    摘要卡片
sentiment  情感分析
cat <type> 分类推送
```

## LLM分析参数

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|------|--------|------|
| model | qwen2.5:1.5b | Ollama模型 |
| timeout | 30s | 超时时间 |
| max_tokens | 200 | 最大Token |
| temperature | 0.3 | 温度(低=一致) |
| workers | 5 | 并行线程 |

## 趋势分析

```bash
# 7天趋势
python news_hub.py trends

# 30天趋势
python news_hub.py trends 30
```

输出示例:
```
[SENTIMENT]
  Total: 69 | + 4 (6%) | - 1 (1%)
  Score: +0.0 | Trend: =

[CATEGORIES]
  other: 52 (75%) ###############

[WEEKLY TREND]
03-23 [=] ############### 69
```

## 定时任务 (Windows)

```batch
schtasks /create /sc daily /st 08:00 /tr "path\to\daily.bat"
schtasks /create /sc daily /st 12:00 /tr "path\to\daily.bat"
schtasks /create /sc daily /st 18:00 /tr "path\to\daily.bat"
```

## 文件结构

```
NewsHub/
├── news_fetcher.py       # 核心抓取 + LLM分析
├── news_analyzer.py      # LLM分析器 v2.0 ⭐
├── news_feishu.py        # 飞书推送
├── news_alerts.py        # 智能告警
├── news_db.py            # 历史数据库
├── news_report.py        # 简报生成
├── news_trends.py        # 趋势分析
├── news_subscriptions.py # 关键词订阅
├── news_hub.py           # 统一入口
├── daily.bat             # 定时任务
└── README.md
```

## 性能

| 功能 | 指标 |
|------|------|
| 并行抓取 | 2.4s (6源67条) |
| LLM分析 | ~2s/条 |
| LLM缓存 | 秒级 (重复) |
| 新闻缓存 | 5分钟TTL |
| 智能告警 | <1s |
| 市场情绪 | <0.5s |

## 版本历史

| 版本 | 日期 | 功能 |
|------|------|------|
| v2.1 | 2026-03-23 | LLM v2.0增强 + 市场情绪卡片 |
| v2.0 | 2026-03-23 | 关键词订阅 + 趋势分析 |
| v1.9 | 2026-03-23 | 智能告警 + 历史数据库 |
| v1.8 | 2026-03-23 | 新闻聚类 + LLM多维分析 |
| v1.7 | 2026-03-23 | 并行LLM + 缓存 |
| v1.6 | 2026-03-23 | 本地LLM分析 |
| v1.5 | 2026-03-23 | 增强分类 + 重要性 |
| v1.0 | 2026-03-21 | 基础功能 |
